extraction: Digitized from the 400 ppi scan of PDF p. 47 with validation/data/digitize/matsunami1983_ipp_am32.py: 2-D affine axis calibration from all ~140 tick marks of the log-log frame (residual rms 0.0048 decade in E, 0.0022 in Y); symbols identified by eye from zoomed rasters (listed in the script) and centred by template matching against the figure's legend glyphs, two template sizes; the fitted curve masked out and not stored. Points with 196 eV <= E <= 10.2 keV only; symbols in that range that could not be identified are listed in the script and not stored. Uncertainties are digitizing only (calibration, centring repeatability and the 1.3 % rms scatter of round-energy points), floored at 2 %; the compilation gives no measurement uncertainty. Energy is the total ion energy, yield in atoms per ion (IPPJ-AM-32, p. 6).
reliability_note: Included in the compilation's Ar -> Si figure, so it passed the compilation's selection (IPPJ-AM-32, pp. 1-2: absolute or normalized-relative yields, room temperature, no dose effects, sufficient beam current; doubtful sets excluded). The compilation does not rank the sets it shows.
terms: Facts, cited; stored under operator decision (#69) despite the compilation's cover note. No figure image and no fitted curve stored.
